Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location, with 4 on hand, and at location B under the same part number.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425696 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425696-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it; switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way. At location B create part A again with the same Part Number.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test at the test location, purchase order 1, from any vendor, with a line for part A picked from the lookup, 2 ordered and none received.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425696-A in Part Number and pick part A from the list, type 2 in Quantity, click Add, then click Save & Close. Do not click Receive.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test at location B, purchase order 2, from any vendor, with a line for part A picked from the lookup, 4 ordered and none received.
    • How to do it: At location B: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425696-A in Part Number and pick part A from the list, type 4 in Quantity, click Add, then click Save & Close. Do not click Receive.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
